meta.title: v0.9 tether (wired) power proposal for TEST and DEMO flights
meta.status: PROPOSAL - not merged. params.json and cad/ were NOT edited; the CAD / sim / firmware rounds merge this.
meta.role: tether power study (user 2026-10-27: '테스트, 시연용 유선 전원'); the competition flight stays battery-powered

computation.check: the script reproduces the sizing report hover point: P(26.22 N) = 1822 W (sizing_report.md: 1822 W)

meta.naming_note: the firmware already has fcu_bench_tether / fcu_bench_hover (a MECHANICAL restraint on the load-cell rig). Name the new power source 'wired' in code (PWR_SRC_WIRED, PWR_SRC_WIRED_BUFFER) to avoid the collision.

model_assumptions.power_vs_thrust: electrical input P = 2264 W (T / T_ref)^1.5 (proxy table 30.30 N @ 22.2 V / 102 A; the two proxy points give exponent 1.578). P1 'proxy efficiency': T_ref = 30.30 N. P2 'proxy full power' (pessimistic): T_ref = T_max of the thrust table (the fan absorbs 2264 W at full throttle but makes only T_max). Thrust ~ u^2, power ~ u^3, T_max ~ V^2.
model_assumptions.vtol_light_note: range from the v0.9 task (the mass-model round gives the real number); 1650 g is the reference below
model_assumptions.wire_model: tinned 0.08 mm strands (10 AWG 1050, 12 AWG 680, 14 AWG 400), rho 1.75e-8 Ohm m x 1.02 lay, silicone 1.20 g/cm3 ASSUMED, ODs 5.5 / 4.5 / 3.5 mm (vendor listings); natural convection 10 W/m2K ASSUMED. Weigh and measure the real wire.

TW_and_hover_throttle_table.note: T/W and u_hover = sqrt(W / T_max) at 22.2 V; overhead feed = lifted tether ~0 (the gantry carries it)

supply_limited_TW_battery_less.note: one RSP-1500-24 at rated power (60 A at 25.2 V) on the recommended 8.5 m 10 AWG route: V_esc 21.69 V, 1301 W at the ESC. T/W available = thrust at 1301 W / weight; P1 / P2.
supply_limited_TW_battery_less.conclusion: with the proxy efficiency one 1.5 kW supply gives T/W >= 1.3 for every VTOL-light case up to 1.65 kg; with a weak fan (P2, T_max <= 2.3 kgf) it does not even reach 1.3 and at 2.0 kgf it cannot hover. Buy the supply only AFTER the thrust test.

lifted_tether_g.note: two conductors + 3 g/m strength member, vertical segment x 1.10 (ASSUMED); only for a hanging (bottom/side) exit - the recommended overhead feed puts ~0 on the vehicle
lifted_tether_g.conclusion: a 10 m low-voltage tether weighs 0.6-1.5 kg = 1.8-4.4 x the 349 g battery: no tethered field flights at 10 m

tether_electrical_ref.note: VTOL1650 battery-less + 12 AWG hanging 1.5 m (1555 g): hover 808 W, T/W1.3 1198 W (P1); supply 25.2 V

conductor_temperature_rise_K.note: lumped model, still air 10 W/m2K ASSUMED; [60 s, 120 s, steady]

recommended_route.wire: 2 x 10 AWG silicone (1050 x 0.08) + Dyneema 2 mm strength member + 0.3-0.5 m bungee shock section near the vehicle
recommended_route.12AWG_same_route: R 89.8 mOhm: hover 22.4 V, T/W1.3 peak 20.8 V (battery-less) - not recommended for the 8.5 m route

hybrid_crossover.rule: I_x = (V_supply - V_buffer_ocv) / R_loop. Below I_x the tether alone carries the load and the buffer is idle; above it the buffer shares. Choose V_buffer so that 1.2 x I_hover(measured) <= I_x <= 0.9 x I_supply_rated.
hybrid_crossover.recommended: buffer stored at 3.80 V/cell (22.8 V) -> I_x 40 A > hover 33.7 A (P1) and < 60 A (RSP-1500-24 at 25.2 V). Re-set after the thrust test: in the P2 2.3 kgf case the hover is 55.6 A > I_x and the buffer would drain in hover.

falls_VTOL1650.reference: FAA 14 CFR 107.120 Category 2 limit 11 ft-lb = 14.9 J (not a Korean rule, a scale for 'can injure'); the vehicle's own parachute landing is 37 J (sizing report)

buffer_landing_6S_650mAh.note: landing time = (h - flare)/v_descent + flare/v_touch + 1 s; buffer at 21.5 V under load ASSUMED
buffer_landing_6S_650mAh.conclusion: 650 mAh is enough in energy; in the pessimistic thrust case (C rate ~100) use the 6S 1100 mAh 100C (211 g) instead

regen_risk.conclusion: a tethered bus that cannot sink current (supply, or a diode-blocked bus) must have a brake-chopper clamp; the bench test measures whether the SkyWalker V2 regenerates on throttle reductions

lc_damping.note: loop L 0.6 uH/m ASSUMED; with a 4 mF bank at the ESC: 8.5 m -> f0 1.1 kHz, zeta 0.82, 50 A step -> 1.8 V; with the ESC's own ~0.88 mF ASSUMED: zeta 0.38, 3.8 V

i_bench_thrust_test.power: the flight-type 6S 2200 70C LiPo (fully charged), preferably two in parallel; NOT a bench supply (220 W was ~10 % of the 2264 W full power; even a 1.5 kW / 60 A supply cannot reach full throttle, 102-124 A by the proxy)
instruments: inline watt meter >= 150 A (V, A, W, peak)
bidirectional current (Hall clamp or shunt + scope) for regeneration on throttle step-downs
steps: sweep 0-100 % in 10 % steps, 3 s each (>= 80 %: 2 s), rest between steps; fresh pack and ~23 V pack
regen check: 80 % -> 50 % steps and KILL from 80 %; record negative current and V_esc overshoot
tether rehearsal: the same pack on the ground through the real 8.5 m 10 AWG pair: steady 30 / 40 / 50 A, V drop, ESC input ripple (scope, AC), cap temperature after 60 s
i_bench_thrust_test.decision: fit T(P) at 1.3-1.7 kgf; buy one RSP-1500-24 only if the supply-limited T/W (table above) >= 1.3 for the measured mass

ii_tethered_test_flights.vehicle: battery-less (wired) variant; fall prevented mechanically by the belayed catch line (slack <= 0.3 m)
ii_tethered_test_flights.ground_power_start: the user's 6S 2200 packs in parallel on the ground (no mains, absorbs regeneration), 100 A fuse + disconnect at the pack: 3.4 / 6.7 min to 80 % with 1 / 2 packs at the P1 hover (31.5 A at 22 V; P2 2.3 kgf: 2.2 / 4.3 min at 49 A); 2 x CNHL 6S 4000: 12.2 / 7.8 min
ii_tethered_test_flights.ground_power_later: Mean Well RSP-1500-24 at 25.2 V, remote ON/OFF to an E-stop
ii_tethered_test_flights.rig: overhead gantry (pulley/ring >= 1.0 m above the vehicle top at the highest test altitude), tether = 2 x 10 AWG + Dyneema strength member + bungee shock section, held over the pulley by a handler (belay)
ii_tethered_test_flights.profile: demo-like heights: hover 1.0-1.5 m, alt_max 2.0 m while tethered

iii_public_demo.vehicle: hybrid (tether + 6S 650 mAh buffer behind ideal diodes) so a tether cut / supply trip ends in a powered landing
iii_public_demo.ground_power: RSP-1500-24 at 25.2 V (CC 105-135 % for 5 s then latch-off: the buffer takes the peaks before the limit); SE-1500-24 only for the hybrid (it shuts down at 105-125 %; no CC phase stated)
iii_public_demo.rig: same gantry + belayed catch line; spectators behind a barrier; indoor fully enclosed hall; hover 1.5 m, alt_max 2.0 m
iii_public_demo.fallback: the battery VTOL demo profile without a tether (40 s flight limit, no leash)

recommendation.competition: battery (no tether) unless the rules allow otherwise
not_recommended: tethered field flights at 10 m: the lifted tether alone is 0.6-1.5 kg

high-voltage tether + onboard DC-DC: a 384 V -> 24 V Vicor BCM4414 module is USD 950 (DigiKey) plus a HV ground supply and lethal-voltage handling; ~179 g at 3 m, ~290 g at 10 m onboard (ASSUMED) - no gain over the 349 g battery below ~10 m

bottom / fin-tip tether exit: in the jet's mixing layer below ~0.4 m (8-12 m/s at the fin-tip radius 0.5-1.5 m below), 0.5-1 N/m drag, flutter, ground wall jet; moment ~0.38 N m vs ~0.075 N m for the top axis
a buffer pack directly on the bus without D2: the tether would charge a 650 mAh pack at up to ~40 A (60 C) whenever the load is light
server-PSU series stacks for a first build: open-frame mains and output-ground isolation hazards

config_switch.applies_to: mission.config 'vtol' only (the rocket configuration stays battery-powered)

top_entry.location: top cap of the VTOL configuration (above the avionics module, top at ~Z 533 + cap in today's layout), on the vehicle axis
top_entry.hardpoint: M5 stainless eye bolt (or a printed-in eye with a metal insert) through the top cap into a load plate (>= 30 mm dia, 2 mm aluminium or 4 mm printed rib plate) that hands the load to the avionics module tube / joint screws

design_load_N_ASSUMED.note: catch-line arrest of the 1523 g hybrid with a bungee shock section (600 N/m ASSUMED): 60-90 N peak for 0.1-0.3 m slack (computed); WITHOUT a shock section (Dyneema only) 498-851 N - the bungee is mandatory

top_entry.cable_boot: stiff boot / spring guard >= 100 mm long that makes the cable leave UPWARD within +-15 deg of the axis even when slack (a slack cable must never fall down the side past the intake windows)
top_entry.strain_relief: strength member tied to the hardpoint; the two conductors pass a gland / clamp boss (2 x dia 5.8 mm, or one oval 12 x 6.5 mm for 10 AWG OD 5.5) offset <= 25 mm from the axis, then a 100 mm service loop to the XT90-S inside the bay; the connector never carries load
top_entry.connector: XT90-S (anti-spark) between tether and vehicle; the live tether end carries the female (shielded contacts)

inside_avionics_bay.power_lead: 2 x 10 AWG, ~0.25 m, top entry -> ESC input, kept >= 100 mm from the LoRa box where possible
inside_avionics_bay.cap_bank: 4 x 1000 uF 35 V low-ESR (or 50 V) within 50 mm of the ESC power pads (~25 g)
inside_avionics_bay.bus_clamp: brake chopper (comparator + MOSFET + 1-2 Ohm >= 50 W aluminium-clad resistor), on at ~26.6 V, off at ~26.0 V (ASSUMED values) + 26 V-standoff TVS; must stay below the RSP-1500-24 OVP minimum 27.6 V; ~20 g
inside_avionics_bay.hybrid_power_board: D1 (tether) and D2 (buffer) ideal diodes, LM74700-Q1 (3.2-65 V, 20 mV forward regulation, <0.75 us reverse blocking) + 60 V MOSFETs; D2 = two FETs in series so one shorted FET does not open a charge path; ~15 g; dividers for V_tether (before D1) and V_buffer (before D2) to the FCU ADC

battery_bay.wired_buffer: 6S 650 mAh 120C (GNB, 63 x 30 x 31 mm, 100 g; replace the XT30 with an XT60) strapped in the battery slot; alternative 6S 1100 mAh 100C (CNHL, 211 g)

keep_out_checks: no tether hardware or cable path below the top of the avionics module
cable boot exit axis within 15 deg of the vehicle axis; boot top >= 100 mm above the top cap
every point of the cable path >= 200 mm from every intake window (window tops at Z 326.9 vs the top entry above Z ~533: >= 206 mm vertical in today's stack - re-check on the shortened v0.9 stack)
GPS pod off-axis so the hardpoint can sit on the axis (the GPS is not used under the gantry / indoors)

mass_properties.battery_less: -349 g battery at the battery CG (Z ~455 mm today) + ~101 g kit (cap bank / clamp near the ESC, hardpoint at the top): CG moves down; vane lever arm shrinks accordingly - recompute
mass_properties.hybrid: -349 g + 101 g + 121 g (buffer in the battery slot)

cad.not_built: no bottom / fin exit (reasons in recommendation.not_recommended)

sim.new_module: sim/tether.py (or inside sim6dof as an external force like the v0.8 pole pushes)

mechanics.attachment_body_m: top on the axis, from the CAD top-entry point
mechanics.pulley_world_m: above the hover point, height h_p (3.5-4.0 m)

modes.belay: strength member length L_s set by the handler with slack s in [0, 0.3] m; taut -> spring k_b (bungee 600 N/m ASSUMED) + damping c (zeta 0.3 ASSUMED) in series with Dyneema (EA ~3e5 N ASSUMED)
modes.cable_tension: power cable over the pulley: tension at the vehicle T_c = 0.5-2.0 N (handler / balancer, random walk tau 2 s ASSUMED), direction from the attachment toward the pulley

mechanics.lateral_restoring: T_c * dx / L_drop (~0.5 N/m at 1 N, 2 m)

events.jerk: 20 N for 0.2 s at 30 deg from vertical (snag / handler slip)

power.bus: V_esc = V_s - I R_loop (V_s 25.2 V, R_loop 58.5 mOhm on the recommended route); T_max(V) = T_max(22.2) (V/22.2)^2; P(u) from the thrust model
power.supply: rated 60 A at 25.2 V; overload 105-135 % -> constant current (V falls) and latch-off after 5 s (RSP-1500-24 datasheet); SE-1500-24: shut down at 105-125 % (no constant-current phase stated in the datasheet)
power.buffer: OCV(SOC) 6S LiPo, R_int 0.03 Ohm ASSUMED for 650 mAh, discharge-only through D2; supplies when the bus falls below its terminal voltage
power.clamp: bus clamp at 26.6 V (no regeneration into the supply)

sim.plant_spread: thrust model P1 and P2 at T_max 2.0 / 2.3 / 2.6 / 3.09 kgf

scenarios.pass: same criteria as the demo profile

firmware.note: params_gen.h will be STALE after the CAD round merges power.* into params.json - expected; the firmware round regenerates it
firmware.build_profiles: power source at build time: battery (today), wired (battery-less), wired_buffer (hybrid); orthogonal to the field / demo profiles
firmware.adc: V_bus stays on PF0/ADC0 (47k/4.7k, 2.56 V ref: 28.2 V full scale). New: V_tether before D1 and V_buffer before D2 on two free ADC pins (PF4-PF7 are the JTAG pins - choose with the pin map), same divider

rules_ASSUMED_thresholds.rule: ARM gate: V_tether in [24.6, 25.6] V at idle; wired_buffer also V_buffer rest in [3.72, 3.92] V/cell
rules_ASSUMED_thresholds.else: refuse ARM with a reason code

rules_ASSUMED_thresholds.rule: wired_buffer: V_tether < 20.0 V or < V_buffer - 0.5 V for >= 40 ms while POWERED
rules_ASSUMED_thresholds.action: LAND (new reason TETHER_LOST), UP disabled, telemetry flag, ground alarm

rules_ASSUMED_thresholds.rule: V_bus < 21.0 V for >= 0.3 s while the tether is present (supply in current limit or a long thin tether)
rules_ASSUMED_thresholds.action: freeze the throttle ceiling at the present u and warn; if it lasts >= 2.0 s -> LAND (the RSP latches off after 5 s)
LAND (if not already); never ABORT for it

rules_ASSUMED_thresholds.rule: wired_buffer: V_buffer rising above 3.95 V/cell while tethered (D2 shorted -> charging)
rules_ASSUMED_thresholds.action: alarm, land, the ground cuts the supply

rules_ASSUMED_thresholds.rule: battery: unchanged (v_cell = V_bus / 6); wired: I8 replaced by W_SAG; wired_buffer: I8 on V_buffer

wired profiles: max_flight_s 180, land_reserve_s from the buffer (wired_buffer) - limited by the 10 AWG heating (40-50 A: +12-20 K in 120 s, computed) and the motor temperature (measure on the tether bench)
wired profiles: throttle down-slew limit du/dt >= -2.0 /s ASSUMED (no regeneration); KILL / ABORT still cut at once (coast)

telemetry_ground_station: log fields for all three voltages
firmware.kill: unchanged; the supply remote ON/OFF E-stop is a ground-side cut (hybrid: lands on the buffer; battery-less: falls into the belay)

datasheet.overload: 105-135 % constant current, shut down after 5 s, re-power to recover

ground_equipment.fuse: 100 A (ANL / MIDI) at the supply or ground-pack output, ASSUMED

ground_equipment.gantry: two 3.5-4 m light stands + crossbar or a boom stand, pulley / smooth ring at 3.5-4.0 m, sandbags
ground_equipment.tether: 2 x 10 AWG silicone, Dyneema 2 mm, 0.3-0.5 m bungee shock section near the vehicle, spiral wrap or ties every 0.3 m, XT90-S both ends

findings.registration: 시행령 제24조 (non-commercial): no registration for 3호 '계류식 무인비행장치' and for 5호 unmanned powered devices with MTOW <= 2 kg
findings.operator_certificate: 시행규칙 제306조 ① 4호: the certificate covers 무인비행장치 except powered <= 250 g and small airships - NO tethered exemption found; classes by MTOW: 4종 250 g-2 kg (KOTSA online education), 3종 2-7 kg (6 h flight training + written test; practical test reported inconsistently)
findings.flight_approval: 시행규칙 제308조 ① excludes devices of 시행령 제24조 1-4호 (which include 계류식 무인비행장치, non-commercial) and unmanned powered devices <= 25 kg from that paragraph; MOLIT FAQ: flights in a fully enclosed indoor space need no approval
findings.mass_effect: VTOL-light 1.5-1.8 kg with battery, wired 1.25-1.55 kg, hybrid 1.37-1.67 kg: all <= 2 kg -> no registration, 4종; the rocket configuration 2.67 kg -> registration + 3종
